title: At Risk trend line has twelve monthly points and the last equals the count
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in a location (workplace) with several months of invoice history (many customers, invoices going back more than a year). At Risk needs old invoices, which cannot be back-dated by hand.
  3. Customer V: with the At Risk Customers window on 120 Days, an at-risk customer whose newest invoice is from 2 to 6 months ago and who also has an older invoice. You have written down both invoice dates.
  4. Your role can reverse an invoice (Admin can).
custom_steps:
1. Take a screenshot of the At Risk Customers tile.
  2. Count the points on the trend line, from left to right.
  3. Hover over each point and write down the month and the value it shows. If the line shows no values on hover, compare heights only.
  4. Compare the last (right-most) point with the headline.
  5. Click Work Orders, open V's newest invoiced work order, Finance tab > the invoice's three dots > Reverse > confirm. (If Reverse is not offered because the invoice is paid, first reverse its payment on Customers > V > Payments.)
  6. Click Dashboard, set the window to 120 Days, take a second screenshot and repeat steps 2 to 4.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The trend line has twelve points, one per month, for the last twelve months.
  • The right-most point equals the headline (e.g. both 12).
  • After reversing V's newest invoice, one or more of the earlier points change, not only the last one: every point is worked out again from today's data rather than kept from the past.
  • If the points show no values on hover, judge from the two screenshots and write "point values not checked by hand" in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9577 (S5); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, S5 (S5-R13). Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, captured 2026-09-28) used for on-screen labels and navigation only: boards 01_Opens_After, 09_AtRisk_After.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R13: “The At Risk Customers sparkline shows the at-risk count over the trailing twelve months as twelve monthly points. Each historical point is the at-risk count as of the last day of that month in the workplace's timezone, using the inactivity window the tile currently shows. The twelfth point is computed as of now, rather than as of a month end that has not happened yet, so it always equals the headline. Every point is recomputed from current data, so a later void changes the past points: recording the count as it stood at the time would contradict S3-E2, which excludes a voided invoice even when deciding a customer's most recent invoice.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
